query: Are travellers required to bring their passport along when travelling to Malaysia, given that they can now use a QR code for immigration clearance?
reference_answer: The QR code can only be used for immigration clearance at Singapore land checkpoints via car, motorcycle, lorry and bus.Travellers are reminded to bring their passports when travelling overseas, as it remains the official travel document for identification during overseas travel.
answer: No, travellers are not required to bring their passport to Malaysia. They can now use a QR code for immigration clearance instead. [Document 1]
